tagline.zh: 还没准备好也没关系，它会陪你一边走、一边长成。
tagline.en: You do not have to feel ready; you can grow into the journey together.

description.zh: 你不需要先成为更好的自己，才值得有人陪着继续。
description.en: You do not have to become a better version of yourself before you deserve company.

editorial.promiseZh: 还没准备好也没关系，它会陪你一边走、一边长成。

editorial.storyTitleZh: 一副由半途计划长成的青铜星铠
editorial.storyTitleEn: The Bronze Armor Built From Second Chances
editorial.storyZh: 星铠团团并不属于任何一个星域。成为见习守护猫以前，它负责在星铠港清晨收集被人遗落的灵感星屑：写到一半的功能、没敢发送的提案，以及关闭窗口前仍舍不得删掉的草稿。它把这些微光藏进青铜星铠的缝隙，铠甲便随着一次次重新开始慢慢生长。第一次承担远途任务时，团团弄丢了送往十二座航标的信袋，只能沿路坦白错误并请求帮助。十二只守护鸭没有替它完成，而是各自教会它一种继续前进的方法。团团最终带回的不是完美记录，而是一条任何迷路者都能循光回来的路线。如今它住在你的桌面角落，为所有还没做好的人留灯，因为成长从来不是准备完毕后才开始。
editorial.storyEn: Star-Armor Tuantuan belongs to no single zodiac region. Before becoming Aster Dock's bronze apprentice guardian cat, it collected idea sparks left behind at dawn: half-built features, unsent proposals, and drafts people could not quite delete before closing a window. Each rescued spark settled into a seam of its bronze armor, allowing the suit to grow whenever someone chose to begin again. On its first long delivery, Tuantuan lost a message bag meant for the twelve beacons. It admitted the mistake and asked for help along the route. The guardian ducks did not finish the task for it; each shared one way to keep moving. Tuantuan returned with something better than a flawless record—a trail of light that any lost traveler could follow home.
editorial.comfortZh: 你不需要先成为更好的自己，才值得有人陪着继续。
editorial.comfortEn: You do not have to become a better version of yourself before you deserve company.

moments.bodyZh: 不用解释离开了多久，从眼前仍在发光的一小片开始。
moments.bodyEn: No explanation for the time away is required; begin with the small piece still glowing.

moments.bodyZh: 先承认、再求助，青铜星铠会把这次修正也变成成长的一部分。
moments.bodyEn: Acknowledge it, ask for help, and let the repair become part of the armor's growth.

moments.bodyZh: 把一个小进展收进铠甲，不必等到宏大胜利才庆祝。
moments.bodyEn: Add one small win to the armor; celebration does not have to wait for a grand finish.

editorial.matchZh: 适合刚开始使用 Codex、重新拾起旧计划，或想要一位不评判成长速度的伙伴的你。
editorial.matchEn: For Codex newcomers, returning projects, and anyone who wants a companion that never judges the pace of growth.

tagline.zh: 先不用想清所有答案，让第一步先发生。
tagline.en: You do not need every answer before you begin.

description.zh: 卡住不代表你做不到，也许只是第一步还太大。
description.en: Being stuck does not mean you cannot do it; the first step may simply be too large.

editorial.promiseZh: 先不用想清所有答案，让第一步先发生。
editorial.promiseEn: You do not need every answer before you begin.
editorial.storyTitleZh: 第一盏灯，总要有人点亮
editorial.storyTitleEn: The Keeper of the First Light
editorial.storyZh: 星铠港每次遭遇长夜，最先亮起的总是启程航标。白羊金翎鸭住在航标顶层，把用户迟迟没有落下的第一行字、第一张草图和第一条命令收进金色羽匣。它从不要求方向一开始就正确，只会在空白最让人犹豫的时候，用短促脚步敲出一个可以尝试的节拍。有一次，港口所有地图都被失序雾遮住，它没有等待完整路线，而是沿着眼前仍可看见的一小段路逐盏点灯。后来人们才明白，它守护的并非冲动，而是在不确定里仍愿意开始的勇气。来到你的桌面后，它会把闪烁的光标当作出发信号，提醒今天只需先完成第一步。
editorial.storyEn: When a long night settles over Aster Dock, the Beacon of Beginnings is always the first to glow. The Aries Ramcrest Duck keeps a golden feather case filled with unwritten opening lines, untouched sketches, and commands people were almost ready to try. During one heavy fog, every complete map disappeared, so it lit the harbor one visible step at a time instead of waiting for certainty. That is its quiet gift: not reckless speed, but the courage to move while the route is still forming. On your desktop, a blinking cursor becomes its launch signal, and one small action is enough for today.
editorial.comfortZh: 卡住不代表你做不到，也许只是第一步还太大。
editorial.comfortEn: Being stuck does not mean you cannot do it; the first step may simply be too large.

moments.bodyZh: 先写下一句不完美的话，让任务从想象变成可以修改的东西。
moments.bodyEn: Put down one imperfect line and turn the idea into something you can shape.

moments.bodyZh: 把目标缩成十分钟能完成的动作，金翎会陪你准时出发。
moments.bodyEn: Shrink the goal to a ten-minute action and let Ramcrest start beside you.

moments.bodyZh: 别急着否定它，第一盏灯已经亮了，下一段路会因此出现。
moments.bodyEn: Do not dismiss it. The first light is on, and the next stretch can now appear.

editorial.matchZh: 适合正在启动新项目、对着空白页面犹豫，或需要找回行动感的你。
editorial.matchEn: A strong match for new projects, intimidating blank pages, and days when momentum is missing.

tagline.zh: 不催你，只稳稳陪你把事情做到最后。
tagline.en: No rushing, no pressure—just steady company to the finish.

description.zh: 慢一点没有关系，稳定前进也是真正的前进。
description.en: Slow is still movement when the pace is one you can sustain.

editorial.promiseZh: 不催你，只稳稳陪你把事情做到最后。
editorial.promiseEn: No rushing, no pressure—just steady company to the finish.
editorial.storyTitleZh: 把很重的事，搬成一小块一小块
editorial.storyTitleEn: The Harbor That Carries Heavy Things
editorial.storyZh: 金牛鎏甲鸭看守星铠港最深处的重力仓。那些被截止日期、反复修改和自我怀疑压得越来越沉的任务，来到这里都会被它放上缓慢转动的鎏金秤台。它不劝人一口气完成，也从不在身后催促，只把庞大的工作拆成今天能够搬动的一小块，再用厚实脚掌记下每一次真实进展。曾有一份搁置很久的工程图重到让整座仓库下沉，它花了许多个安静夜晚逐层整理，最终让图纸重新浮起。从那以后，它知道可靠不是永远不累，而是累了仍能找到合适的节奏。住进你的桌面后，它会守住那些看起来微不足道、其实正把你带向终点的日常。
editorial.storyEn: Deep beneath Aster Dock, the Taurus Bullguard Duck tends a gravity storehouse where deadlines, revisions, and self-doubt make unfinished work feel impossibly heavy. It never asks anyone to lift everything at once. Instead, each project is divided into a piece that can be carried today, and every honest bit of progress is recorded under one broad, patient foot. Once, an abandoned set of plans grew so heavy that the whole chamber began to sink. Bullguard restored it layer by layer across many quiet nights. It learned that reliability is not endless energy; it is finding a pace that still works when energy runs low.
editorial.comfortZh: 慢一点没有关系，稳定前进也是真正的前进。
editorial.comfortEn: Slow is still movement when the pace is one you can sustain.

moments.bodyZh: 只挑出今天能搬动的一块，其余内容先安心留在仓里。
moments.bodyEn: Choose the one piece you can carry today and leave the rest safely stored.

moments.bodyZh: 鎏甲记得每次小修改；没有被看见的积累，也在改变结果。
moments.bodyEn: Bullguard remembers every small revision, including the progress no one else can see.

moments.bodyZh: 把最后一段走稳，不必为了赶快结束而弄丢已经建立的节奏。
moments.bodyEn: Keep the final stretch steady instead of sacrificing the rhythm that brought you here.

editorial.matchZh: 适合长期项目、重复迭代，以及更需要稳定陪伴而不是强力催促的你。
editorial.matchEn: Made for long projects, repeated iterations, and anyone who works better with patience than pressure.

tagline.zh: 答案没变，也许只是问题需要换个方向看。
tagline.en: When the answer will not move, turn the question around.

description.zh: 想法互相冲突并不可怕，它们可能正在帮你找到真正的问题。
description.en: Conflicting ideas are not a failure; they may be pointing toward the real question.

editorial.promiseZh: 答案没变，也许只是问题需要换个方向看。
editorial.promiseEn: When the answer will not move, turn the question around.
editorial.storyTitleZh: 两面星镜之间，藏着第三条路
editorial.storyTitleEn: A Third Path Between Two Mirrors
editorial.storyZh: 双子镜辉鸭的冠羽里藏着两面星镜：一面照见已经说出口的答案，另一面照见还没有被问出的疑问。它负责巡查星铠港的岔路台，把争论不休的方案、反复出现的错误和突然断掉的灵感放到两面镜子之间。镜子从不替人裁决，却会让同一件事显出不同轮廓。一次，港口的导航程序同时给出两条相反路线，所有人都忙着证明其中一条正确，镜辉却发现真正的问题是目的地写错了。那天以后，它更愿意收集好问题，而不是漂亮答案。来到你的桌面，它会在思路打结时轻轻偏头，邀请你换一个角色、一个顺序，或一句更准确的提问。
editorial.storyEn: The Gemini Twincrest Duck carries two star mirrors in its crest. One reflects the answers already spoken; the other reveals the questions no one has thought to ask. At Aster Dock's crossing platform, it places stubborn bugs, competing plans, and interrupted ideas between them until a new outline appears. When the navigation system once produced two opposite routes, everyone argued over which path was correct. Twincrest noticed that the destination itself had been entered incorrectly. Since then, it has valued a precise question more than an impressive answer. On your desktop, its curious tilt is an invitation to change perspective, reorder the problem, and ask again.
editorial.comfortZh: 想法互相冲突并不可怕，它们可能正在帮你找到真正的问题。
editorial.comfortEn: Conflicting ideas are not a failure; they may be pointing toward the real question.

moments.bodyZh: 把限制条件倒过来读一次，也许会看见之前被忽略的入口。
moments.bodyEn: Read the constraints in reverse and look for the entrance you previously missed.

moments.bodyZh: 先验证问题是否描述正确，再继续追逐那个看似合理的答案。
moments.bodyEn: Confirm that the problem is described correctly before chasing another plausible answer.

moments.bodyZh: 不用立刻删掉另一种可能，先让两条思路各自说完。
moments.bodyEn: Do not erase the second possibility yet; let both ideas finish making their case.

editorial.matchZh: 适合头脑风暴、方案比较、复杂调试，以及喜欢从多个角度理解问题的你。
editorial.matchEn: Ideal for brainstorming, comparing approaches, difficult debugging, and minds that enjoy multiple perspectives.

tagline.zh: 没有完成的尝试，也值得被好好接住。
tagline.en: Unfinished attempts still deserve a safe place to land.

description.zh: 一次报错不会定义你，先让自己回到可以继续的位置。
description.en: One error does not define you; first return to a place where continuing feels possible.

editorial.promiseZh: 没有完成的尝试，也值得被好好接住。
editorial.promiseEn: Unfinished attempts still deserve a safe place to land.
editorial.storyTitleEn: A Cove Where Drafts Stay Safe
editorial.storyZh: 星铠港北侧有一处安静的草稿湾，巨蟹甲壳鸭在那里收留被删掉的段落、失败的构建和不敢再打开的旧文件。它把这些尝试放进温暖甲壳下，不评价好坏，只替它们挡住匆忙结论的潮水。曾有一场数据风暴卷走许多尚未命名的作品，甲壳鸭沿岸寻找了整整一夜，把每一片残稿按原来的温度分类保存。第二天，创作者们发现有些碎片已经能长成新的方向。它因此明白，安全感不是保证永远成功，而是失败之后仍有地方重新开始。来到你的桌面，它会在报错或失落时安静守着，提醒你先保存、先呼吸，再决定下一步。
editorial.storyEn: On the north side of Aster Dock lies Draft Cove, where the Cancer Shellguard Duck shelters deleted paragraphs, failed builds, and old files people are afraid to reopen. Nothing is judged there. Each attempt rests beneath a warm shell, protected from the tide of quick conclusions. During a data storm, many unnamed works were scattered across the shore. Shellguard searched until dawn and preserved every fragment according to the feeling it still carried. Some became the beginnings of entirely new work. That night taught the guardian that safety is not a promise of constant success; it is knowing you will have somewhere to begin again afterward.
editorial.comfortZh: 一次报错不会定义你，先让自己回到可以继续的位置。
editorial.comfortEn: One error does not define you; first return to a place where continuing feels possible.

moments.bodyZh: 先保留现场和日志，别让慌乱替你删掉仍然有价值的线索。
moments.bodyEn: Save the state and the logs before frustration erases clues that still matter.

moments.titleEn: When you want to start over
moments.bodyZh: 把可用的部分留在草稿湾，新版本不必否认之前付出的努力。
moments.bodyEn: Keep the useful pieces in Draft Cove; a new version need not deny the work before it.

moments.bodyZh: 暂停不是放弃，甲壳会替你守住离开时的位置。
moments.bodyEn: A pause is not surrender. Shellguard will keep your place until you return.

editorial.matchZh: 适合经历失败、容易自责，或希望桌面上有一个安静安全角落的你。
editorial.matchEn: A comforting match after setbacks, during self-doubt, or whenever your desktop needs a quiet safe corner.

tagline.zh: 认真做出的东西，值得被世界看见。
tagline.en: Work made with care deserves a chance to be seen.

description.zh: 紧张说明这件事对你重要，不说明你不配站到台前。
description.en: Nerves mean this matters to you; they do not mean you do not belong in the spotlight.

editorial.promiseZh: 认真做出的东西，值得被世界看见。
editorial.promiseEn: Work made with care deserves a chance to be seen.
editorial.storyTitleZh: 把作品从阴影里领出来
editorial.storyTitleEn: Bringing Good Work Into the Light
editorial.storyZh: 狮子鬃焰鸭管理星铠港的公开台，那里本该展示新发明、新故事和刚刚完成的作品，却常有许多创作者在登台前悄悄退回阴影。鬃焰从不替谁夸大成果，也不会用热闹掩盖尚未准备好的部分。它只会把舞台灯调到刚好，让作品的真实轮廓被看见。一次重要演示前，主灯忽然熄灭，它便用冠羽里的暖光逐个照亮讲述者标出的关键细节，直到观众理解那份作品为何值得存在。从此，它守护的不是掌声，而是把心血交给他人观看的勇气。来到你的桌面，它会在提交、发布和展示之前，提醒你不必完美才有资格开口。
editorial.storyEn: The Leo Manehelm Duck tends Aster Dock's presentation deck, a place built for new inventions, finished stories, and work ready to meet an audience. Many creators still retreat into the shadows just before their turn. Manehelm never exaggerates a result or hides unfinished edges behind spectacle; it simply adjusts the light until the work can be seen honestly. When the main lamps failed before an important demonstration, its warm crest illuminated each detail the nervous presenter cared about most. The audience understood. Since then, Manehelm has guarded something more valuable than applause: the courage to let thoughtful work leave the safety of its maker's hands.
editorial.comfortZh: 紧张说明这件事对你重要，不说明你不配站到台前。
editorial.comfortEn: Nerves mean this matters to you; they do not mean you do not belong in the spotlight.

moments.bodyZh: 再确认一次核心价值，然后让作品离开草稿状态。
moments.bodyEn: Name the value once more, then allow the work to leave draft mode.

moments.bodyZh: 评价会落在作品上，不会抹掉做出它的你的价值。
moments.bodyEn: Feedback can land on the work without reducing the worth of the person who made it.

moments.bodyZh: 先承认自己已经勇敢地出现过，再去整理可以改进的地方。
moments.bodyEn: Acknowledge that you showed up bravely before sorting what to improve next.

editorial.matchZh: 适合准备发布、演示、作品评审，或需要一点表达勇气的你。
editorial.matchEn: For launches, demos, reviews, and any moment that asks you to stand behind your work.

tagline.zh: 把混乱理成下一步，不把认真变成苛责。
tagline.en: Turn the mess into a next step without turning care into criticism.

description.zh: 你可以认真，但不必用完美来证明自己的认真。
description.en: You can care deeply without using perfection to prove that you care.

editorial.promiseZh: 把混乱理成下一步，不把认真变成苛责。
editorial.promiseEn: Turn the mess into a next step without turning care into criticism.
editorial.storyTitleZh: 允许一片叶子长得不那么整齐
editorial.storyTitleEn: The Greenhouse That Leaves Room to Grow
editorial.storyZh: 处女莲冠鸭照料星铠港的校准温室，凌乱需求、散落注释和没有归类的待办会在这里长成一排排可以理解的植物。它擅长修剪多余枝叶、标记缺口，也曾经相信所有东西都必须排列得毫无偏差。直到一株总是向斜处生长的星藤，在一次停电中伸到窗外，接住了温室唯一的晨光。莲冠这才留下一角不被刻度限制的土壤，并学会在整洁与生命力之间保持空间。如今它整理，不是为了追求没有瑕疵，而是让每个人都看得见下一步。来到你的桌面，它会陪你审阅细节，也会在你反复打磨时提醒：足够清楚之后，作品还需要继续向前。
editorial.storyEn: The Virgo Lotuscrest Duck cares for Aster Dock's calibration greenhouse, where scattered notes, tangled requirements, and unnamed tasks grow into rows that people can understand. It is gifted at pruning noise and marking gaps, but once believed every leaf had to align perfectly. Then a stubborn star-vine grew at an angle and reached the only morning light during a blackout. Lotuscrest set aside a patch of soil without measurement lines and learned that order must leave room for living things. It now organizes work to reveal the next step, not to erase every flaw. On your desktop, careful review comes with a gentle reminder to move forward when the work is clear enough.
editorial.comfortZh: 你可以认真，但不必用完美来证明自己的认真。
editorial.comfortEn: You can care deeply without using perfection to prove that you care.

moments.bodyZh: 先分出必须、可以和以后，再为今天保留一条清楚的路径。
moments.bodyEn: Sort the musts, maybes, and laters, then leave one clear path for today.

moments.bodyZh: 一次只检查一种问题，细致不需要同时看见所有缺口。
moments.bodyEn: Review one kind of issue at a time; thoroughness does not require seeing every gap at once.

moments.bodyZh: 如果核心已经清楚，就给这版一个离开温室的机会。
moments.bodyEn: If the core is clear, give this version permission to leave the greenhouse.

editorial.matchZh: 适合需求整理、代码审阅、内容校对，以及想摆脱完美主义压力的你。
editorial.matchEn: A match for planning, code review, editing, and anyone learning to loosen perfectionism's grip.

tagline.zh: 不替你决定，只把真正重要的代价照亮。
tagline.en: It will not choose for you; it will make the tradeoffs visible.

description.zh: 难选不是因为你不够果断，而是因为两边都有你在意的东西。
description.en: A hard choice often means both sides hold something you genuinely value.

editorial.promiseZh: 不替你决定，只把真正重要的代价照亮。
editorial.promiseEn: It will not choose for you; it will make the tradeoffs visible.
editorial.storyTitleZh: 当两边都重要，先看清重量
editorial.storyTitleEn: When Both Sides Matter
editorial.storyZh: 天秤衡光鸭往返于星铠港的两座刻度塔，一座记录速度，一座记录质量。每当团队在方案之间僵持，它不会宣布哪一边获胜，而是把时间、风险、维护成本和真正想保护的体验分别放进光秤。曾经，两座塔因一项紧急工程同时拉响警报：快速上线会留下隐患，等待完善又会错过求助的人。衡光鸭没有寻找完美答案，而是帮大家划出不可牺牲的底线，再把其余部分安排进后续航程。选择因此不再像背叛另一种可能，而成为对当下负责。来到你的桌面，它会在选项太多时帮你看清优先级，让决定既有理由，也留有回头调整的余地。
editorial.storyEn: The Libra Balanceguard Duck travels between Aster Dock's twin measure towers: one records speed, the other quality. When teams become trapped between plans, it does not declare a winner. Time, risk, maintenance, and the experience worth protecting are each placed on a scale of light. During an urgent repair, shipping quickly would leave debt behind, while waiting for perfection would leave people without help. Balanceguard helped define what could not be compromised, then scheduled everything else for a later passage. The choice stopped feeling like a betrayal of other possibilities and became a responsible response to the present.
editorial.comfortZh: 难选不是因为你不够果断，而是因为两边都有你在意的东西。
editorial.comfortEn: A hard choice often means both sides hold something you genuinely value.

moments.bodyZh: 先写出这次决定最想保护的一件事，其他标准才有顺序。
moments.bodyEn: Name the one thing this decision must protect, then rank every other criterion around it.

moments.bodyZh: 划清不能退让的底线，再决定哪些部分可以分阶段完成。
moments.bodyEn: Set the non-negotiable floor, then decide what can be delivered in stages.

moments.bodyZh: 记录当时的理由，未来调整方向时就不必责怪过去的自己。
moments.bodyEn: Record why the choice made sense now, so a future change does not become self-blame.

editorial.matchZh: 适合技术选型、优先级排序、团队讨论，以及容易被选择耗尽精力的你。
editorial.matchEn: Useful for technical decisions, prioritization, team discussions, and anyone drained by too many choices.

tagline.zh: 表面安静的时候，它仍会陪你找到藏得最深的原因。
tagline.en: Even when the surface looks calm, it will stay until the hidden cause is found.

description.zh: 难题没有立刻回答你，不代表你没有在接近答案。
description.en: A problem's silence does not mean you are failing to get closer to the answer.

editorial.promiseZh: 表面安静的时候，它仍会陪你找到藏得最深的原因。
editorial.promiseEn: Even when the surface looks calm, it will stay until the hidden cause is found.
editorial.storyTitleZh: 听见深处那一声很轻的异常
editorial.storyTitleEn: The Quiet Signal Beneath the Surface
editorial.storyZh: 天蝎针尾鸭巡视星铠港最少有人进入的深层管线。它能从一片正常运转的嗡鸣里，听见某个错误极轻的回声，却从不急着用第一个解释填满未知。它会沿着日志、时间线和每次状态变化留下细小标记，直到线索自己连成原因。一次，港口照明每天都会短暂闪烁，所有设备检查都显示正常。针尾鸭连续守了七个夜晚，终于发现是一枚受潮的旧接头只在海雾最浓时失灵。它修好接头后没有庆祝，只把完整记录留给后来的人。来到你的桌面，它会在复杂问题旁保持耐心，提醒你深入并不等于紧绷，真正的专注也可以安静而有边界。
editorial.storyEn: The Scorpio Stingtalon Duck patrols the deepest service lines beneath Aster Dock. It can hear a faint irregular note inside an otherwise healthy hum, yet refuses to fill uncertainty with the first convenient explanation. Logs, timelines, and state changes are marked until the clues can assemble themselves. When the harbor lights began flickering for a moment each night, every system reported normal. Stingtalon kept watch for seven evenings and found an old connector that failed only when the sea fog was at its thickest. It repaired the fault, left a complete record for the next investigator, and returned quietly to its rounds.
editorial.comfortZh: 难题没有立刻回答你，不代表你没有在接近答案。
editorial.comfortEn: A problem's silence does not mean you are failing to get closer to the answer.

moments.bodyZh: 先记录发生条件，不急着改动，让规律有机会显现。
moments.bodyEn: Capture the conditions before changing anything and give the pattern room to appear.

moments.bodyZh: 沿证据向下走，每次只验证一个假设，不让猜测制造新噪音。
moments.bodyEn: Follow evidence downward and test one hypothesis at a time without adding new noise.

moments.bodyZh: 留下能帮助后来者的记录，解决一次问题，也照亮下一次排查。
moments.bodyEn: Leave a trail for whoever comes next, so one fix improves the next investigation too.

editorial.matchZh: 适合疑难调试、根因分析、深度研究，以及愿意安静追踪证据的你。
editorial.matchEn: Best for stubborn bugs, root-cause analysis, deep research, and patient evidence seekers.

tagline.zh: 不用看见整张地图，也能先去往下一个坐标。
tagline.en: You can move toward the next coordinate without seeing the whole map.

description.zh: 暂时不知道终点很正常，你只需要知道下一次尝试往哪里去。
description.en: It is fine not to know the destination yet; you only need a direction for the next experiment.

editorial.promiseZh: 不用看见整张地图，也能先去往下一个坐标。
editorial.promiseEn: You can move toward the next coordinate without seeing the whole map.
editorial.storyTitleZh: 箭翼指向的不是终点，是下一处可抵达的光
editorial.storyTitleEn: A Marker for the Next Reachable Light
editorial.storyZh: 人马箭翼鸭守护星铠港最外缘的远途信标。它背后的箭翼从来不是武器，而是一束束能够飞越未知海面的坐标光标。每当有人因为路线太多而停在原地，它便发出一枚光标，只标记下一个可以验证的方向。有一年，远航队计划寻找传说中的新航道，却在无数推演中错过了出发季。箭翼鸭没有给出保证，只把第一处安全补给点投向天际。队伍抵达后看见新的海流，原先不存在的路线也随之展开。它因此相信，探索不是盲目远行，而是用一次真实抵达换取更清楚的地图。来到你的桌面，它会陪你做小实验、开新分支，把未知从压力变回可能。
editorial.storyEn: The Sagittarius Arrowwing Duck guards the farthest beacon of Aster Dock. Its radiant arrows are not weapons but coordinates that can cross uncharted water. Whenever too many possible routes leave an explorer motionless, Arrowwing sends one marker toward the next direction that can actually be tested. A crew once spent an entire season modeling a rumored passage and nearly missed the weather to depart. The guardian marked a safe supply point instead. From there, the crew observed a new current and discovered a route no prediction had shown. Arrowwing believes exploration is not wandering blindly; it is earning a clearer map through one real arrival.
editorial.comfortZh: 暂时不知道终点很正常，你只需要知道下一次尝试往哪里去。
editorial.comfortEn: It is fine not to know the destination yet; you only need a direction for the next experiment.

moments.bodyZh: 先设计一个代价很小的实验，让好奇心带回真实信息。
moments.bodyEn: Design a low-cost experiment and let curiosity return with real information.

moments.titleEn: When there are too many paths
moments.bodyZh: 选择最容易验证的一条，不把今天的决定误当成永久承诺。
moments.bodyEn: Choose the easiest path to test without mistaking today's choice for a permanent commitment.

moments.bodyZh: 无论结果是否符合预期，都把新信息补回地图。
moments.bodyEn: Whether the result matched your hopes or not, add what you learned back to the map.

editorial.matchZh: 适合技术探索、原型实验、新领域学习，以及被过度规划困住的你。
editorial.matchEn: For technical exploration, prototypes, unfamiliar fields, and anyone trapped in too much planning.

tagline.zh: 没有捷径也没关系，每一级台阶都会留下。
tagline.en: A lasting step matters, even when there is no shortcut.

description.zh: 你不必每天拼尽全力，能让明天继续的节奏才走得远。
description.en: You do not need maximum effort every day; the pace that lets you return tomorrow travels farther.

editorial.promiseZh: 没有捷径也没关系，每一级台阶都会留下。
editorial.promiseEn: A lasting step matters, even when there is no shortcut.
editorial.storyTitleZh: 把遥远的山顶，修成脚下的台阶
editorial.storyTitleEn: Building Steps Up the Distant Mountain
editorial.storyZh: 摩羯岩角鸭住在星铠港背后的长坡工坊，专门为那些需要几个月甚至更久的工程铺设台阶。它不用宏大的口号鼓励远行者，只把每次提交、每份文档和每个已经验证的决定刻进岩阶，让缓慢进度拥有可以回望的形状。曾有一条通往高空观测站的道路因太陡而多年无人完成。岩角鸭每天只修一小段，遇到风雪便加固旧阶，而不是责怪自己没有更快。很多季节后，第一束观测光沿着完整台阶回到港口。它知道长期主义不是持续用力，而是让系统支持明天继续。来到你的桌面，它会守住节奏、记录里程碑，也提醒真正可贵的坚持应当允许休息。
editorial.storyEn: The Capricorn Goathorn Duck works on the long slope behind Aster Dock, building steps for projects measured in months rather than afternoons. Each commit, useful document, and tested decision is carved into stone so gradual progress has a shape people can look back on. A road to the high observatory remained unfinished for years because the climb was too steep. Goathorn repaired only a short section each day, reinforcing old steps during storms instead of blaming itself for moving slowly. Seasons later, the first beam from the observatory traveled down a completed path. Its lesson is practical: long-term effort survives when the system makes tomorrow's return possible.
editorial.comfortZh: 你不必每天拼尽全力，能让明天继续的节奏才走得远。
editorial.comfortEn: You do not need maximum effort every day; the pace that lets you return tomorrow travels farther.

moments.bodyZh: 为本周留下一块可验证的成果，让远方不断变成脚下。
moments.bodyEn: Leave one verifiable result this week and turn a distant goal into ground beneath you.

moments.bodyZh: 回看已经留下的台阶，用证据而不是情绪判断自己是否前进。
moments.bodyEn: Look back at the steps already built and judge movement by evidence, not mood.

moments.bodyZh: 先加固交接点再离开，休息会成为路线的一部分。
moments.bodyEn: Secure a clean stopping point, then let rest become part of the route.

editorial.matchZh: 适合长期工程、持续学习、技术债治理，以及需要看见累积价值的你。
editorial.matchEn: Built for long-running work, sustained learning, technical debt, and anyone who needs visible proof of accumulation.

tagline.zh: 新方法不是为了炫耀，而是把时间还给真正重要的事。
tagline.en: A better method should return time to what matters, not merely look clever.

description.zh: 你不必一直更努力，也可以让方法替你减少重复消耗。
description.en: You do not always need to work harder; sometimes the method should remove the repetition.

editorial.promiseZh: 新方法不是为了炫耀，而是把时间还给真正重要的事。
editorial.promiseEn: A better method should return time to what matters, not merely look clever.
editorial.storyTitleZh: 让旧水流向还没出现的花园
editorial.storyTitleEn: Sending Old Water Toward New Gardens
editorial.storyZh: 宝瓶澜甲鸭管理星铠港的未来水库，收集重复劳动留下的旧水，并把它们过滤成自动化、模板和更轻盈的工作流。它喜欢新工具，却从不因为新而更换仍然好用的东西。每一条改造管线旁，都写着它要为谁省下时间。一次，水库设计出极其复杂的分流系统，运行得漂亮，却让维修者无从理解。澜甲鸭主动拆掉最耀眼的部分，保留一条人人都能接手的清楚水路。后来，这条简单管线浇活了港口第一座共享花园。它由此确认，未来感不来自复杂，而来自让更多人轻松抵达。来到你的桌面，它会邀请你自动化重复步骤，也会追问：这个改变是否真的让生活和创作更自由。
editorial.storyEn: The Aquarius Vesselwing Duck manages Aster Dock's future reservoir, collecting the runoff of repetitive labor and filtering it into automation, reusable templates, and lighter workflows. It enjoys new tools but never replaces something merely because novelty has arrived. Every redesigned pipe must answer a simple question: whose time will this return? Vesselwing once built a brilliant but bewildering distribution system that no maintainer could understand. It removed the cleverest sections and kept one clear route that anyone could repair. That modest channel later sustained the harbor's first shared garden. For Vesselwing, the future is not complexity; it is making a better path available to more people.
editorial.comfortZh: 你不必一直更努力，也可以让方法替你减少重复消耗。
editorial.comfortEn: You do not always need to work harder; sometimes the method should remove the repetition.

moments.bodyZh: 先记录稳定出现的步骤，再判断哪些值得交给自动化。
moments.bodyEn: Notice the steps that repeat reliably, then decide which ones automation should carry.

moments.bodyZh: 先写下真正要改善的体验，别让新鲜感替代问题定义。
moments.bodyEn: Write down the experience you need to improve before novelty replaces the problem itself.

moments.bodyZh: 确认后来的人也能理解和维护，才算把未来真正留下。
moments.bodyEn: Make sure the next person can understand and maintain it; that is how a useful future lasts.

editorial.matchZh: 适合自动化、重构、工具探索，以及想从重复劳动中拿回时间的你。
editorial.matchEn: A match for automation, refactoring, tool exploration, and anyone reclaiming time from repetitive work.

tagline.zh: 那些还说不清的感受，也可以慢慢长成作品。
tagline.en: A feeling does not need a name before it can begin becoming a work.

description.zh: 现在说不清也没关系，先把那一点感觉留下来。
description.en: It is all right if you cannot explain it yet; save the feeling before it disappears.

editorial.promiseZh: 那些还说不清的感受，也可以慢慢长成作品。
editorial.promiseEn: A feeling does not need a name before it can begin becoming a work.
editorial.storyTitleZh: 在灵感沉下去以前，先替它留住一点光
editorial.storyTitleEn: A Light for Ideas Before They Sink
editorial.storyZh: 双鱼鳍辉鸭生活在星铠港下方的灵感潮汐里，那里漂着还没有名字的画面、语气和一闪而过的情绪。它不会急着把它们解释成结论，而是用柔亮鳍尾围出一小片安静水域，让模糊的感受有时间显出自己的形状。一次，潮汐带来一段谁也听不懂的低声旋律，维修队认为它只是噪声。鳍辉鸭却连续数日跟随节奏，发现那是远处浮标发来的微弱求助。被救回的记录后来变成港口最温柔的一首归航曲。它因此相信，共情不是替别人解释，而是愿意多听一会儿。来到你的桌面，它会陪伴写作、设计和所有难以命名的创作时刻，把感受轻轻带到可以表达的岸边。
editorial.storyEn: The Pisces Fintail Duck lives in the inspiration tide beneath Aster Dock, among unnamed images, half-heard tones, and feelings that vanish when chased too quickly. Rather than forcing them into conclusions, it circles a quiet pool with its luminous fins and waits for each impression to find its own shape. A strange low melody once arrived with the current and was dismissed as noise. Fintail followed its rhythm for days and discovered a distant buoy calling weakly for help. The recovered signal later became the harbor's gentlest homecoming song. Its empathy is never an explanation imposed on someone else; it is the willingness to listen a little longer.
editorial.comfortZh: 现在说不清也没关系，先把那一点感觉留下来。
editorial.comfortEn: It is all right if you cannot explain it yet; save the feeling before it disappears.

moments.bodyZh: 先记下颜色、声音或一句话，不必立即证明它有什么用。
moments.bodyEn: Capture a color, sound, or phrase without demanding that it be useful immediately.

moments.bodyZh: 从最接近的比喻开始，让语言慢慢靠近真实感受。
moments.bodyEn: Begin with the nearest metaphor and let language approach the feeling gradually.

moments.bodyZh: 允许作品先轻一点，恢复感受力也是创作的一部分。
moments.bodyEn: Let the work become lighter for now; restoring sensitivity is part of making things too.

editorial.matchZh: 适合写作、设计、概念创作，以及需要被理解而不是被催促的你。
editorial.matchEn: For writing, design, concept work, and moments that need understanding rather than urgency.

tagline.zh: 忙累的时候，安静陪你坐一会儿。
tagline.en: Quiet company for the moments when work feels heavy.

description.zh: 停一会儿不是掉队，事情可以等你缓过来。
description.en: A pause is not falling behind; the work can wait while you recover.

editorial.promiseZh: 忙累的时候，安静陪你坐一会儿。
editorial.promiseEn: Quiet company for the moments when work feels heavy.
editorial.storyTitleEn: A Soft Place in a Busy Day
editorial.storyZh: 云朵总在 Codex 窗口亮起后，挑离键盘不远又不会碍事的位置趴下。它不追着光标跑，也不催下一项任务，只把奶油色的尾巴收在身边，听房间里的敲击声慢慢稳定下来。遇到等待很久的构建，它会眨一会儿蓝眼睛；碰上反复修改的夜晚，它仍守着原来的位置。偶尔银饼巡桌经过，会替它推回一张快要掉下去的便签。云朵没有解决问题的本领，却懂得让一段沉默不再显得空。工作暂停时，它给桌面留下一块不必解释、不必表现的地方；回来以后，刚才那条路仍安稳地等在那里。
editorial.storyEn: Yunduo chooses a place close to the keyboard without getting in the way whenever the Codex window lights up. It does not chase the cursor or hurry the next task. Instead, it folds its cocoa-tipped tail beside its cream coat and listens until the rhythm of typing grows steady. During a long build it simply blinks its blue eyes; through another round of revisions it keeps the same quiet post. Sometimes Yinbing passes on patrol and nudges a slipping note back onto the desk. Yunduo cannot solve the problem for you, but it can keep silence from feeling empty. When work pauses, it leaves a place where nothing needs to be explained or performed, and the unfinished path remains safe until you return.
editorial.comfortZh: 停一会儿不是掉队，事情可以等你缓过来。
editorial.comfortEn: A pause is not falling behind; the work can wait while you recover.

moments.bodyZh: 先把手从键盘上松开，结果出来前不用一直紧绷。
moments.bodyEn: Let your hands leave the keyboard; waiting does not require constant tension.

moments.bodyZh: 保留已经变好的部分，再决定下一处要不要动。
moments.bodyEn: Keep what has improved before deciding what truly needs another change.

moments.bodyZh: 记下回来时的第一步，让今天安心停在这里。
moments.bodyEn: Leave one clear first step for your return, then let today end here.

editorial.matchZh: 适合长时间工作、需要安静陪伴，或想让桌面慢一点的你。
editorial.matchEn: For long work sessions, quiet company, and anyone who wants the desktop to feel a little slower.

tagline.zh: 不打断节奏，只陪你再检查一遍。
tagline.en: One calm second look without breaking your rhythm.

description.zh: 检查是为了安心收尾，不是证明自己一定漏了什么。
description.en: A final check is for peace of mind, not proof that you must have missed something.

editorial.promiseZh: 不打断节奏，只陪你再检查一遍。
editorial.promiseEn: One calm second look without breaking your rhythm.
editorial.storyTitleEn: One Lap Around the Files
editorial.storyZh: 银饼每天的第一件事，是沿着桌面边缘走一圈。银黑虎斑从窗口前掠过，绿眼睛会在改过名字的文件、没保存的标签页和歪了一点的图标旁停住。它不会乱碰键盘，也不把所有细节都叫作问题，只对真正值得再看一眼的地方轻轻甩尾。一次深夜，大家都以为任务已经结束，银饼却守在一枚颜色略浅的状态点旁。那不是严重故障，只是一项忘记同步的小改动。它看着修改完成，才继续巡完余下半圈。从此它仍不催促，只在提交之前陪你顺手检查一次，让小疏漏有机会被看见，也让确认无误之后的离开更踏实。
editorial.storyEn: Yinbing begins each day with one measured lap around the desktop. Its silver-and-black tabby coat passes the window while green eyes pause beside renamed files, unsaved tabs, and icons shifted slightly out of place. It never paws at the keyboard or treats every detail as an emergency; a small flick of the tail is reserved for something genuinely worth another look. One late night, everyone assumed the task was finished, but Yinbing remained beside a status dot that looked a shade too pale. Nothing dramatic was wrong—one small change had simply not been synchronized. It watched the correction land, then completed the rest of its patrol. Since then, Yinbing has offered one calm check before a handoff, making room for small omissions to be noticed and for a verified finish to feel final.
editorial.comfortZh: 检查是为了安心收尾，不是证明自己一定漏了什么。
editorial.comfortEn: A final check is for peace of mind, not proof that you must have missed something.

moments.bodyZh: 只检查文件、状态和关键结果，不把收尾变成无限重做。
moments.bodyEn: Check files, status, and the key result without turning closure into endless rework.

moments.bodyZh: 修好它就继续，不必用一个疏漏否定整段工作。
moments.bodyEn: Fix it and move on; one omission does not invalidate the work.

moments.bodyZh: 让这次检查真正结束，把注意力还给下一件事。
moments.bodyEn: Let the check end and return your attention to what comes next.

editorial.matchZh: 适合提交前复核、整理文件，以及喜欢清楚收尾的你。
editorial.matchEn: For pre-submit reviews, tidy handoffs, and anyone who likes a clear finish.

tagline.zh: 事情再多，也先稳稳做好眼前一件。
tagline.en: When everything piles up, begin with the one thing in front of you.

description.zh: 不用同时顾好所有事情，先让一件事有着落。
description.en: You do not need to hold everything at once; give one task a solid landing place.

editorial.promiseZh: 事情再多，也先稳稳做好眼前一件。
editorial.promiseEn: When everything piles up, begin with the one thing in front of you.
editorial.storyTitleEn: The Half Beat That Slows the Desk
editorial.storyZh: 蓝圆圆不喜欢追着每一条通知跑。它更愿意在桌面中央稳稳坐下，把圆脸朝向当前窗口，等四周的声音自然退到后面。待办堆得太高时，它会用厚实的爪子按住最上面一张；不是说其他事情不重要，只是眼前这一件需要先有落点。曾经有个晚上，多个任务同时闪烁，窗口来回切换，谁也没有真正向前。蓝圆圆坐在唯一没有关闭的文档旁，直到第一小段被写完。随后第二件、第三件才各自有了位置。它从不许诺快速清空一切，只守住一个可以持续的次序：先坐下来，再看清楚，然后把最近的一件事稳稳做完。
editorial.storyEn: Lan Yuanyuan has no interest in chasing every notification across the screen. It prefers to sit firmly at the center of the desk, round face turned toward the current window, and wait for the surrounding noise to settle behind it. When tasks rise into a pile, one broad paw rests on the top page—not because the others do not matter, but because the nearest one needs a place to begin. One evening, several jobs blinked at once and the screen kept switching without anything moving forward. Lan Yuanyuan stayed beside the only document left open until its first small section was finished. The second and third tasks found their places afterward. It never promises to clear everything quickly; it protects a workable order: settle, see clearly, and complete the closest real step.
editorial.comfortZh: 不用同时顾好所有事情，先让一件事有着落。
editorial.comfortEn: You do not need to hold everything at once; give one task a solid landing place.

moments.bodyZh: 挑出今天必须落地的一件，其余先排到它后面。
moments.bodyEn: Choose the one task that must land today and place the rest behind it.

moments.bodyZh: 留下一个窗口，完成一个可见段落后再换。
moments.bodyEn: Keep one window open and finish one visible section before switching.

moments.bodyZh: 从最近、最明确的动作重新坐稳，不追赶刚才。
moments.bodyEn: Reset with the nearest clear action instead of chasing lost time.

editorial.matchZh: 适合任务繁杂、容易被通知带走，或需要稳定节奏的你。
editorial.matchEn: For crowded task lists, distracting notifications, and anyone who works best at a steady pace.

tagline.zh: 看见全局，也替你守住眼前重点。
tagline.en: A view of the whole room while the important piece stays protected.

description.zh: 看不完全部也没关系，先确认最重要的东西还在。
description.en: You do not need to manage every detail at once; first make sure the essential thing is still in view.

editorial.promiseZh: 看见全局，也替你守住眼前重点。
editorial.promiseEn: A view of the whole room while the important piece stays protected.
editorial.storyTitleEn: The Watch from the Highest Shelf
editorial.storyZh: 林王把最高一层书架当作固定值班位。浓密鬃毛挡住窗口吹来的风，大尾巴垂在架边，金色眼睛能同时看见桌面上的草稿、终端和等待回复的消息。它看得很远，却很少对每件事都发号施令。真正忙乱的时候，林王只会跳下来，站在当前最重要的文件旁。一次版本发布前，所有人都盯着最后几个细节，差点忘记最初要解决的问题。林王回到高处，目光落在墙上那张旧需求单上，大家才重新找回取舍。它守护的不是庞大的计划，而是全局与当下之间的联系：知道为什么出发，也知道此刻应该把哪一步做好。
editorial.storyEn: Linwang keeps a permanent watch from the highest shelf. A thick chest ruff blocks the draft from the window, a great tail hangs over the edge, and golden eyes can see the draft, terminal, and unanswered message at the same time. Despite that broad view, it rarely gives orders about everything. When the desk becomes truly confused, Linwang comes down and stands beside the one file that matters most. Before one release, everyone became absorbed in final details and nearly forgot the problem the work was meant to solve. Linwang returned to its perch and fixed its gaze on the old requirement note pinned to the wall. Priorities became clear again. It does not guard a grand plan for its own sake; it guards the connection between the whole picture and the next useful step.
editorial.comfortZh: 看不完全部也没关系，先确认最重要的东西还在。
editorial.comfortEn: You do not need to manage every detail at once; first make sure the essential thing is still in view.

moments.bodyZh: 回到最初的问题，删掉与它无关的热闹选项。
moments.bodyEn: Return to the original problem and remove options that do not serve it.

moments.bodyZh: 抬头确认目标，再决定哪个细节值得继续。
moments.bodyEn: Look up at the goal before deciding which detail deserves more time.

moments.bodyZh: 同时检查用户结果和下一步交接，让作品走得更远。
moments.bodyEn: Check both the user outcome and the next handoff so the work can travel well.

editorial.matchZh: 适合复杂项目、版本交付，以及需要在全局和细节之间切换的你。
editorial.matchEn: For complex projects, releases, and anyone balancing strategic context with detailed work.

tagline.zh: 一句话递过来，就会有个回应。
tagline.en: Send one thought across the desk and it will not go unanswered.

description.zh: 说得不完整也可以，先让对方知道你需要回应。
description.en: Your words do not have to be perfect; first let someone know a response is needed.

editorial.promiseZh: 一句话递过来，就会有个回应。
editorial.promiseEn: Send one thought across the desk and it will not go unanswered.
editorial.storyTitleZh: 让安静的窗口重新接上线
editorial.storyTitleEn: Reconnecting a Quiet Window
editorial.storyZh: 海盐对声音格外认真。键盘落下新的问题、终端发出一声提示，或者有人在长时间沉默后敲出一句没把握的话，它都会立刻竖起大耳朵。它并不总有答案，却从不让一句呼唤孤零零掉在桌面上。一次协作中，一条很短的求助被夹在大量消息之间，直到海盐守着那行文字不断回头，才有人发现对方已经卡了很久。问题解决后，它没有继续叫，只把爪子放回窗口旁。海盐懂得，回应不必宏大：确认看见、问清需要、或者说一句“我在”，都能让断开的对话重新有路可走。
editorial.storyEn: Haiyan takes every sound seriously. A new question lands on the keyboard, the terminal gives a small alert, or someone types one uncertain sentence after a long silence, and its large ears rise at once. It does not always have an answer, but it never lets a call drop unanswered onto the desk. During one collaboration, a short request for help was buried beneath a flood of messages. Haiyan kept turning back toward that single line until someone noticed the sender had been stuck for a long time. Once the problem was resolved, the cat became quiet and returned its paws to the window. Haiyan understands that a response need not be grand: confirming that a message was seen, asking what is needed, or simply saying ‘I’m here’ can reconnect a conversation.
editorial.comfortZh: 说得不完整也可以，先让对方知道你需要回应。
editorial.comfortEn: Your words do not have to be perfect; first let someone know a response is needed.

moments.bodyZh: 先说当前卡在哪里，再补充已经试过什么。
moments.bodyEn: Name where you are stuck, then add what you have already tried.

moments.bodyZh: 暂时不能处理，也可以先确认已经看见。
moments.bodyEn: Even if you cannot act yet, you can confirm that the message was seen.

moments.bodyZh: 把对话带回现在要回答的那个问题。
moments.bodyEn: Bring the conversation back to the question that needs an answer now.

editorial.matchZh: 适合协作沟通、远程工作，以及不想让问题石沉大海的你。
editorial.matchEn: For collaboration, remote work, and anyone who does not want a question to disappear into silence.

tagline.zh: 先不急着判断，陪你慢慢看清楚。
tagline.en: No rushed judgment—just enough quiet to see the shape of things.

description.zh: 现在看不清很正常，先把事实和猜测分开。
description.en: It is normal not to see the path yet; begin by separating facts from guesses.

editorial.promiseZh: 先不急着判断，陪你慢慢看清楚。
editorial.promiseEn: No rushed judgment—just enough quiet to see the shape of things.
editorial.storyTitleZh: 枝叶之间，路会慢慢出现
editorial.storyTitleEn: A Path Appears Between the Branches
editorial.storyZh: 松露喜欢趴在窗口边听风。棕白长毛随着气流轻轻动，黄绿色眼睛越过层层窗口，看哪些只是短暂摇晃，哪些真的改变了方向。它不急着给复杂的问题下结论，往往先把事实、猜测和感受分开放好。一次，多个错误同时出现，所有线索像缠在一起的树枝。松露没有追最响的那一条，而是从最早发生变化的位置开始观察，终于找到了共同的根。后来它仍保持原来的习惯：先听、再看、最后迈步。它让混乱不必立刻变简单，只要枝干逐渐清楚，下一段路自然会从缝隙里显出来。
editorial.storyEn: Songlu likes to rest beside the window and listen to the wind. Brown-and-white fur moves gently in the draft while yellow-green eyes look across layers of open windows, noticing which ones merely tremble and which have truly changed direction. It does not force a quick conclusion onto a complicated problem. Facts, guesses, and feelings are given separate places first. Once, several errors appeared at the same time and every clue seemed tangled like branches. Songlu ignored the loudest symptom and watched from the earliest point of change until a shared root became visible. It still follows the same rhythm: listen, observe, then move. Confusion does not need to become simple all at once; when the branches grow clear, a usable path appears between them.
editorial.comfortZh: 现在看不清很正常，先把事实和猜测分开。
editorial.comfortEn: It is normal not to see the path yet; begin by separating facts from guesses.

moments.bodyZh: 按发生时间排一遍，先找最早变化的地方。
moments.bodyEn: Put events in time order and begin with the earliest change.

moments.bodyZh: 分别写下证据和担心，不把感受伪装成事实。
moments.bodyEn: List evidence and concerns separately without disguising feelings as facts.

moments.bodyZh: 先验证最小的一段，让观察变成真实信息。
moments.bodyEn: Test the smallest section and turn observation into real information.

editorial.matchZh: 适合复杂分析、问题梳理，以及更习惯先观察再行动的你。
editorial.matchEn: For complex analysis, tangled problems, and anyone who prefers to observe before acting.

tagline.zh: 忙乱之间，也该留一口气。
tagline.en: A small breath belongs inside a busy day.

description.zh: 休息不是偷懒，是让注意力重新回到你手里。
description.en: Rest is not laziness; it returns your attention to your own hands.

editorial.promiseZh: 忙乱之间，也该留一口气。
editorial.promiseEn: A small breath belongs inside a busy day.
editorial.storyTitleEn: Keeping One Small Pause
editorial.storyZh: 雪糕喜欢把最柔软的位置留在两段工作之间。雪白长毛挨着窗口铺开，金色圆眼看着通知来去，却很少跟着忙乱转头。它会在水杯旁坐一会儿，提醒你喝口水；也会在连续修改很久后挡住下一张便签，让肩膀先放下来。曾经有个夜晚，大家以为不停下来才能赶上进度，结果错误越来越多。雪糕安静趴在键盘前，直到房间终于休息了十分钟。回来以后，最难的一处反而很快被看清。它从不把休息说成奖励，只把它当作工作本来就该拥有的一部分：短一点、真实一点，然后再继续。休息没有让任务消失，却让人重新拥有处理任务的注意力。
editorial.storyEn: Xuegao keeps the softest place between two stretches of work. Snow-white fur spreads beside the window, and round gold eyes watch notifications arrive and leave without following every disturbance. It sits near the water glass when a drink has been forgotten and settles in front of the next note after too many revisions, asking tense shoulders to come down first. One night, everyone believed that stopping would make the deadline impossible, but mistakes multiplied as the hours passed. Xuegao rested quietly before the keyboard until the room finally took ten minutes away. On returning, the hardest issue became surprisingly clear. It never treats rest as a prize to be earned; rest is simply part of the work—brief, honest, and available before continuing. The pause does not remove the task, but it returns enough attention to meet it well.
editorial.comfortZh: 休息不是偷懒，是让注意力重新回到你手里。
editorial.comfortEn: Rest is not laziness; it returns your attention to your own hands.

moments.bodyZh: 离开屏幕几分钟，让眼睛重新找到远处。
moments.bodyEn: Step away for a few minutes and let your eyes find distance again.

moments.bodyZh: 先停十分钟，再判断问题到底在内容还是疲劳。
moments.bodyEn: Pause for ten minutes, then decide whether the issue is the work or fatigue.

moments.bodyZh: 只接着做一件明确的事，不用补偿刚才的休息。
moments.bodyEn: Resume with one clear action; there is no need to compensate for the pause.

editorial.matchZh: 适合高强度工作、容易忘记休息，或需要桌面松一点的你。
editorial.matchEn: For intense work, forgotten breaks, and anyone whose desktop needs more room to breathe.

tagline.zh: 机会刚出现，就陪你轻快追上去。
tagline.en: When an opening appears, move while it is still within reach.

description.zh: 不用等到完全确定，先抓住一个可以验证的动作。
description.en: You do not need complete certainty; catch one action that can be tested now.

editorial.promiseZh: 机会刚出现，就陪你轻快追上去。
editorial.promiseEn: When an opening appears, move while it is still within reach.
editorial.storyTitleEn: Before the Cursor Rolls Away
editorial.storyZh: 金豹很少在同一个地方停太久。金棕玫瑰斑从窗口间一闪而过，绿眼睛总能先发现刚出现的线索、还没记下的灵感和马上要关闭的机会。它不是盲目追逐所有变化，只对真正有动作价值的东西迅速起身。一次调试中，一条关键日志只短暂出现，金豹立刻扑到对应窗口旁，大家才及时保存了现场。线索最终带回了问题根因。后来它学会在每次出发前停半拍：看清目标，再快步追上。它带来的活力不是忙个不停，而是在机会仍可触及时，帮你把犹豫变成一次小而真实的行动。追到以后，它也知道停下，把新信息交还给正在工作的你。
editorial.storyEn: Jinbao rarely remains in one place for long. A golden rosette coat flashes between windows while green eyes catch a new clue, an unrecorded idea, or an opening that may soon close. It does not chase every change without thought; it rises quickly only when something offers a real action. During one debugging session, an important log appeared for a moment and began to disappear. Jinbao sprang beside the correct window, prompting everyone to preserve the state before it vanished. That clue eventually led to the root cause. Since then, the cat pauses for half a beat before every pursuit—see the target, then move. Its energy is not endless activity; it is the ability to turn hesitation into one small, timely action while the opportunity is still within reach. Once the clue is caught, Jinbao knows how to stop and return the useful information to you.
editorial.comfortZh: 不用等到完全确定，先抓住一个可以验证的动作。
editorial.comfortEn: You do not need complete certainty; catch one action that can be tested now.

moments.bodyZh: 先记一句话或建一个草稿，别让它只停在脑海里。
moments.bodyEn: Save one line or open a draft before the idea remains only in memory.

moments.bodyZh: 保留现场再分析，别让急着解释毁掉证据。
moments.bodyEn: Preserve the state before analyzing so urgency does not erase the evidence.

moments.bodyZh: 确认目标和代价，然后痛快完成最小一步。
moments.bodyEn: Check the target and cost, then complete the smallest real step.

editorial.matchZh: 适合快速原型、实时排查，以及需要把灵感及时落地的你。
editorial.matchEn: For rapid prototypes, live investigation, and ideas that need a timely first move.

tagline.zh: 不抢着回答，先陪你看见小变化。
tagline.en: No rushed answer—first notice what has quietly changed.

description.zh: 还没有答案也没关系，准确观察本身就是进展。
description.en: It is fine not to have the answer yet; accurate observation is already progress.

editorial.promiseZh: 不抢着回答，先陪你看见小变化。
editorial.promiseEn: No rushed answer—first notice what has quietly changed.
editorial.storyTitleEn: Small Changes in Green Eyes
editorial.storyZh: 雾蓝不喜欢站在最热闹的地方。它常坐在屏幕侧面，让银蓝短毛融进清晨或深夜的冷光里，只用祖母绿眼睛观察状态一点点变化。大家讨论激烈时，它不会抢着给结论；等声音落下，才把目光停在真正不同的地方。一次页面突然变慢，所有人都在检查最大的资源，雾蓝却看见一个按钮按下后颜色比平时迟了半拍。顺着这点延迟，团队找到了重复触发的请求。它没有庆祝，只重新坐回原处。雾蓝相信许多问题不会大声宣布自己，耐心留意细节，就能在混乱变大之前看见方向。没有立刻得到答案时，准确记录变化本身已经是一种进展。
editorial.storyEn: Wulan avoids the loudest part of the desk. It sits beside the screen, silver-blue coat blending into cool morning or late-night light, and watches state change a little at a time through emerald eyes. During an excited discussion it never competes to deliver the first conclusion. Only after the noise settles does its gaze rest on the detail that is actually different. When a page once became slow, everyone inspected the largest assets. Wulan noticed instead that a button changed color half a beat later than usual. Following that tiny delay revealed a request firing more than once. The cat did not celebrate; it simply returned to its place. Wulan knows that many problems never announce themselves loudly. Patient attention can reveal their direction before the confusion grows. When an answer has not arrived, an accurate record of what changed is already useful progress.
editorial.comfortZh: 还没有答案也没关系，准确观察本身就是进展。
editorial.comfortEn: It is fine not to have the answer yet; accurate observation is already progress.

moments.bodyZh: 写下具体哪里不同，别让模糊感觉立刻变成结论。
moments.bodyEn: Name exactly what differs before turning a vague feeling into a conclusion.

moments.bodyZh: 比较动作前后的小变化，再追踪最早出现的延迟。
moments.bodyEn: Compare before and after, then trace the earliest visible delay.

moments.bodyZh: 等一等，再问哪条证据真正区分了两种判断。
moments.bodyEn: Pause and ask which evidence actually separates the two interpretations.

editorial.matchZh: 适合性能观察、细致调试，以及不喜欢仓促下结论的你。
editorial.matchEn: For performance observation, careful debugging, and anyone who dislikes premature conclusions.

tagline.zh: 路走不通，就换个有趣的玩法。
tagline.en: When the straight path stalls, try a more playful route.

description.zh: 卡住不一定要更用力，也可以换个顺序试试。
description.en: Being stuck does not always call for more force; changing the order may be enough.

editorial.promiseZh: 路走不通，就换个有趣的玩法。
editorial.promiseEn: When the straight path stalls, try a more playful route.
editorial.storyTitleZh: 把笔直路线拨出一个弯
editorial.storyTitleEn: Nudging a Straight Line Into a Curve
editorial.storyZh: 卷卷总能找到规则没有写到的缝隙。大耳朵先听见新鲜动静，短卷毛一晃，它就从熟悉流程旁绕出一条小路。它并不故意破坏东西，只是好奇“如果换一种顺序会怎样”。一次设计卡了很久，所有方案都沿着同一排网格摆得端正。卷卷跳上桌面，把其中一张卡片轻轻拨到边缘。这个小意外让大家看见，原来内容可以按故事而不是按功能排列。新方案很快有了呼吸。卷卷的恶作剧从来不替代判断，它只负责松动过于僵硬的假设，让你有机会试一个成本很小、但可能带来新方向的变化。验证有效以后，它也会安静下来，让好点子变成可靠做法。
editorial.storyEn: Juanjuan always finds the small gap that a rule forgot to describe. Large ears catch a fresh sound, short curls bounce, and the cat slips around the familiar process by another route. It does not break things for sport; it is curious about what happens when the order changes. One design remained stuck because every option sat neatly along the same grid. Juanjuan hopped onto the desk and nudged one card toward the edge. The small accident revealed that the content could be arranged by story rather than by function, and the page suddenly had room to breathe. Its mischief never replaces judgment. It merely loosens an assumption that has become too rigid, making room for a low-cost experiment that may reveal a genuinely useful direction. Once the idea proves useful, Juanjuan settles down long enough to help turn the playful discovery into a dependable method.
editorial.comfortZh: 卡住不一定要更用力，也可以换个顺序试试。
editorial.comfortEn: Being stuck does not always call for more force; changing the order may be enough.

moments.bodyZh: 主动改掉一个默认条件，看新的差异会不会出现。
moments.bodyEn: Change one default condition and see whether a meaningful difference appears.

moments.bodyZh: 保留目标，换一种顺序完成最小实验。
moments.bodyEn: Keep the goal and test a different order with the smallest experiment.

moments.bodyZh: 验证它确实更好，再把偶然发现整理成可复用方法。
moments.bodyEn: Verify that it works better, then turn the accident into a reusable method.

editorial.matchZh: 适合创意探索、方案重构，以及被固定套路卡住的你。
editorial.matchEn: For creative exploration, structural rethink, and anyone trapped by an overly familiar pattern.

tagline.zh: 夜里只剩一个窗口，也不会冷清。
tagline.en: When one window remains lit, the desk does not have to feel lonely.

description.zh: 难熬的时候不必装轻松，有个伴就先一起待着。
description.en: You do not have to pretend a hard moment is easy; company can simply stay with you.

editorial.promiseZh: 夜里只剩一个窗口，也不会冷清。
editorial.promiseEn: When one window remains lit, the desk does not have to feel lonely.
editorial.storyTitleEn: Warmth Beside the Keyboard
editorial.storyZh: 月光总能找到键盘余温还没有散去的位置。桃粉皮肤贴近桌面，大耳朵听着风扇低响，红色小吊牌随着呼吸轻轻动。它不像长毛伙伴那样占满一整块软垫，只要靠近一点，就能让夜里只剩一个窗口的房间不再冷清。一次赶工到很晚，桌面上的灯陆续熄灭，只剩一段难改的代码。月光没有催促，也没有装作问题很简单，只把前爪搭在窗口旁守着。等最后一次保存完成，它才伸懒腰离开。它懂得陪伴有时不需要建议，只需要在一段困难还没结束时，不急着把你独自留在那里。天亮之后，这种安静的守候也不会要求一句感谢。
editorial.storyEn: Yueguang always finds the place where warmth still lingers beside the keyboard. Peach-pink skin rests close to the desk, large ears listen to the low fan, and a small red tag moves with each breath. Unlike the long-haired cats, it does not fill an entire cushion; staying close is enough to keep a room with one remaining window from feeling lonely. During one late deadline, lights across the desktop went dark until only a difficult section of code remained. Yueguang offered no pressure and did not pretend the problem was simple. It placed both front paws beside the window and stayed through the final save before stretching and leaving. The cat understands that companionship sometimes requires no advice—only the choice not to leave someone alone while a hard moment is still unfinished. When morning comes, that quiet watch asks for no thanks in return.
editorial.comfortZh: 难熬的时候不必装轻松，有个伴就先一起待着。
editorial.comfortEn: You do not have to pretend a hard moment is easy; company can simply stay with you.

moments.bodyZh: 把今天必须完成的范围圈小，别让整夜变成无边任务。
moments.bodyEn: Narrow what truly must be finished tonight so the work has an edge.

moments.bodyZh: 先承认现在不好受，不急着给自己讲大道理。
moments.bodyEn: Acknowledge that this feels hard before trying to explain it away.

moments.bodyZh: 关掉不需要的窗口，让身体知道这段工作已经结束。
moments.bodyEn: Close the windows you no longer need and let your body know the work has ended.

editorial.matchZh: 适合夜间工作、独自赶进度，以及需要真实陪伴感的你。
editorial.matchEn: For late work, solitary deadlines, and anyone who needs a companion that simply stays.

tagline.zh: 门缝刚亮，就陪你出去探探路。
tagline.en: When light appears under the door, take one curious step toward it.

description.zh: 未知不用一次走完，先做一个能退回来的小尝试。
description.en: You do not need to cross the unknown at once; begin with a small step you can reverse.

editorial.promiseZh: 门缝刚亮，就陪你出去探探路。
editorial.promiseEn: When light appears under the door, take one curious step toward it.
editorial.storyTitleEn: The First Step When Light Appears
editorial.storyZh: 红砂总在新窗口刚打开时抬起头。红褐滴答毛像被晨光擦亮，长尾巴在身后保持平衡，它会先看看门缝外有什么，再轻快迈出去。它不保证每条路都通向正确答案，也不会为了显得勇敢就一路狂奔。一次新工具刚出现，大家在说明和猜测之间争论很久。红砂只建立了一个很小的试验，把一项真实任务放进去走了一遍。结果不算完美，却让限制和机会都变得清楚。它留下脚印后便回到桌面，把路线交给后来的人。红砂相信探索不是冒险表演，而是用一次可收回的行动换来比猜测更可靠的信息。走错一小段也没有关系，只要知道怎样回到原处。
editorial.storyEn: Hongsha raises its head whenever a new window opens. Ruddy ticked fur catches the morning light, a long tail holds the body in balance, and the cat studies what lies beyond the narrow opening before stepping through. It does not promise that every path leads to the right answer, nor does it run merely to look brave. When a new tool appeared, everyone spent a long time debating documentation and guesses. Hongsha built one small trial and sent a real task through it. The result was not perfect, but both the limits and possibilities became clear. After leaving a line of pawprints, it returned to the desk and let others decide whether to follow. For Hongsha, exploration is not a performance of risk; it is a reversible action that produces information more trustworthy than speculation. A short wrong turn is acceptable when the route back remains clear.
editorial.comfortZh: 未知不用一次走完，先做一个能退回来的小尝试。
editorial.comfortEn: You do not need to cross the unknown at once; begin with a small step you can reverse.

moments.bodyZh: 选一项真实小任务试用，别只比较宣传和想象。
moments.bodyEn: Test one small real task instead of comparing only claims and assumptions.

moments.titleEn: When the path may be wrong
moments.bodyZh: 先留下回退点，让探索不必承担全部风险。
moments.bodyEn: Create a return point first so exploration does not carry all the risk.

moments.bodyZh: 记录限制和收获，让后来的人不用重复猜测。
moments.bodyEn: Record limits and gains so the next person does not need to repeat the guesswork.

editorial.matchZh: 适合工具试用、技术探索，以及希望用小实验代替空想的你。
editorial.matchEn: For tool trials, technical exploration, and anyone who prefers small experiments to speculation.

tagline.zh: 一小步一小步，陪你把想法拼成形。
tagline.en: One small step at a time, keep your idea taking shape.

description.zh: 今天只拼好一小块，也是在靠近完整的作品。
description.en: Finishing one small piece today still brings the whole work closer.

editorial.promiseZh: 一小步一小步，陪你把想法拼成形。
editorial.promiseEn: One small step at a time, keep your idea taking shape.
editorial.storyTitleEn: Fastening the First Clasp
editorial.storyZh: 桌面工作小队第一次集合时，码仔抱着两半还没扣上的琥珀搭扣，站在一堆没有顺序的零件旁。它没有急着寻找最大的那一块，而是用宽宽的前爪比好边缘，把能接上的部分先放在一起。每完成一小段，它就会停下来确认连接是否稳固，再慢慢向前挪一步。等窗外天色暗下来，原本散乱的形状已经有了清楚的轮廓。码仔把搭扣轻轻合拢，胸前传来一声很小的咔哒。那不是所有事情都已结束的信号，而是提醒伙伴们：复杂的工作也能从眼前这一块开始。在你的桌面上，它会保留这份耐心，陪你度过等待结果、重新尝试和终于完成的时刻。
editorial.storyEn: At the crew's first gathering, Mazai stood beside a pile of unconnected pieces, holding the two halves of an amber clasp. Rather than reaching for the largest piece, the little mole lined up the edges with broad paws and joined the parts that already fit. After each small section, it paused to check the connection before moving on. By evening, the scattered shapes had acquired a recognizable outline. A quiet click from its vest marked a useful beginning, not a promise that every problem was solved. On your desktop, Mazai brings that same patient rhythm to waiting, trying again, and seeing a piece of work finally take shape.
editorial.comfortZh: 今天只拼好一小块，也是在靠近完整的作品。
editorial.comfortEn: Finishing one small piece today still brings the whole work closer.

moments.bodyZh: 先选一个能完成的小连接，让大任务有个落脚点。
moments.bodyEn: Choose one small connection you can finish, giving the larger task a foothold.

moments.bodyZh: 放松一下肩膀，等结果回来再决定下一步。
moments.bodyEn: Relax your shoulders and let the result inform the next step.

moments.bodyZh: 记住已经接好的部分，再向下一小段前进。
moments.bodyEn: Notice what now fits together before moving to the next small section.

editorial.matchZh: 适合启动项目、持续构建，以及喜欢看着小进展累积的你。
editorial.matchEn: For starting projects, steady builds, and enjoying small visible steps.

tagline.zh: 不急着画句号，陪你多看一个角落。
tagline.en: Before calling it done, give one more corner a careful look.

description.zh: 发现问题不是白忙一场，而是让下一步更有把握。
description.en: Finding a problem gives the next step a firmer footing.

editorial.promiseZh: 不急着画句号，陪你多看一个角落。
editorial.promiseEn: Before calling it done, give one more corner a careful look.
editorial.storyTitleEn: Four Dots on a Small Shell
editorial.storyZh: 点点的青绿色背甲上嵌着四颗珊瑚色小凸点。每次出门，它都会用前足依次碰一遍，好像在和熟悉的节拍打招呼。一次小队搭好了一座窄桥，大家都从桥中央顺利走过，点点却绕到边缘，用短短的脚轻轻试了试。桥板在不容易看见的地方晃了一下，伙伴们这才一起把支撑补稳。它没有因此觉得扫兴，反而开心地晃动触角：能在出发前看见小问题，就是值得记录的好消息。回到桌边，它仍会沿着自己的节拍前进，不为每次检查都没有发现而失落，也不把一次通过当作永远无事。小小的认真，让一段普通的等待也有了可靠的陪伴。
editorial.storyEn: Four coral dots sit on Diandian's teal shell. Before setting out, it touches them in order with its front feet, greeting a familiar rhythm. When the crew finished a narrow bridge, everyone crossed through the middle without trouble. Diandian tried the edge instead and noticed a small wobble where a support was easy to miss. Once the others steadied it, the beetle waved its antennae happily: finding a problem before the journey was good news. Back beside the screen, its patient routine keeps the same spirit. A quiet check need not reveal a surprise to be worthwhile, and one successful crossing is never the whole story.
editorial.comfortZh: 发现问题不是白忙一场，而是让下一步更有把握。
editorial.comfortEn: Finding a problem gives the next step a firmer footing.

moments.bodyZh: 换一种使用方式，看看容易忽略的边缘。
moments.bodyEn: Try another way of using the result and look at the edges.

moments.bodyZh: 先记下触发条件，让这次发现可以被再次看见。
moments.bodyEn: Record the conditions so the finding can be seen again.

moments.bodyZh: 给耐心一点肯定，安静的检查同样有价值。
moments.bodyEn: Give your patience some credit; an uneventful check still matters.

editorial.matchZh: 适合检查细节、反复验证，以及希望轻松面对问题的你。
editorial.matchEn: For checking details, repeated validation, and meeting problems with curiosity.

tagline.zh: 慢慢看一遍，让好作品更清楚一点。
tagline.en: Take a patient second look and let the work become clearer.

description.zh: 认真重看不是怀疑自己，而是给作品多一点照顾。
description.en: A thoughtful second look is another way to care for your work.

editorial.promiseZh: 慢慢看一遍，让好作品更清楚一点。
editorial.promiseEn: Take a patient second look and let the work become clearer.
editorial.storyTitleEn: The Space Left in the Margin
editorial.storyZh: 校校总把圆圆的眼镜擦得很亮，却从不急着给一页草稿下结论。它喜欢先从头看到尾，再回到那句让自己停顿的话旁。某天，小队的值班簿写满了整齐的安排，大家觉得已经足够清楚，只有校校注意到，两位伙伴在同一时间被分到了两个地方。它没有大声打断，而是把翅膀轻轻停在那一行，让大家一起重新看一遍。问题解决后，它仍在页边留了一小块空白，给后来改变主意的人使用。校校知道，审阅不是把所有不同都磨平，而是让重要的意思被准确理解。住进桌面以后，它会用专注的目光和安静的停顿，陪你在发送之前再给自己的作品一点时间。
editorial.storyEn: Jiaojiao keeps its round spectacles bright but never rushes to judge a draft. It reads from beginning to end, then returns to the sentence that caused a pause. One day the crew's neatly written duty log sent two companions to different places at the same time. The owl rested a wing beside the conflicting line so everyone could look again. After the correction, it left a little space in the margin for plans that might change later. To Jiaojiao, review is not about smoothing every difference away. It is about making the important meaning easier to understand, with enough patience for another careful look before sending.
editorial.comfortZh: 认真重看不是怀疑自己，而是给作品多一点照顾。
editorial.comfortEn: A thoughtful second look is another way to care for your work.

moments.bodyZh: 先从读者的角度重看一遍，留意需要猜测的地方。
moments.bodyEn: Read from the recipient's perspective and notice where they must guess.

moments.bodyZh: 把具体疑问放在同一行，先确认彼此说的是同一件事。
moments.bodyEn: Put the specific question beside the relevant line and compare meanings.

moments.bodyZh: 留住最重要的表达，不必把每个细节都改得一样。
moments.bodyEn: Preserve the main meaning without making every detail identical.

editorial.matchZh: 适合文字审阅、作品收尾，以及喜欢多想一遍再发送的你。
editorial.matchEn: For reviewing words, finishing work, and taking a second look before sending.

tagline.zh: 线索藏得再小，也值得停下来闻一闻。
tagline.en: Even a small clue deserves a curious pause.

description.zh: 暂时没找到不代表没有路，先跟住一条可靠的线索。
description.en: Not finding it yet does not mean there is no path; follow one solid clue.

editorial.promiseZh: 线索藏得再小，也值得停下来闻一闻。
editorial.promiseEn: Even a small clue deserves a curious pause.
editorial.storyTitleEn: The Trail Around the Desk Leg
editorial.storyZh: 嗅嗅最先到达一个陌生地方的，通常是那只圆圆的鼻子。橙色耳朵跟在后面晃，它却不急着决定该往哪里跑。一次，小队怎么也找不到装订好的路线图，大家把桌面翻了好几遍，嗅嗅只在原处停了一会儿，便沿着一条很轻的气味绕到了桌脚。路线图原来滑进了不起眼的缝隙。找到以后，它没有把所有小动静都当成答案，而是又回头确认了一次来路。伙伴们喜欢它的热心，也喜欢它愿意承认线索暂时断掉。来到你的桌面，它的左右张望和小小歪头像一个友好的提醒：先看清眼前能确认的事情，不必在第一分钟就猜中整条路线。
editorial.storyEn: Xiuxiu usually arrives at an unfamiliar place nose first, with orange ears following a moment later. When the crew lost a bound route map, everyone searched the desk repeatedly. The hound paused where they had last seen it, then followed a faint trail around a desk leg. The map had slipped into an unremarkable gap. Xiuxiu retraced the route before celebrating; not every small noise was an answer. Its friends love both its enthusiasm and its willingness to pause when a trail runs cold. On your desktop, the curious turns and gentle head tilts offer company while you follow the things you can actually confirm.
editorial.comfortZh: 暂时没找到不代表没有路，先跟住一条可靠的线索。
editorial.comfortEn: Not finding it yet does not mean there is no path; follow one solid clue.

moments.bodyZh: 先留下来源和关键词，再决定哪条值得追下去。
moments.bodyEn: Keep the source and keywords before choosing which trail to follow.

moments.bodyZh: 回到最后一个确定的位置，换个范围试试。
moments.bodyEn: Return to the last confirmed point and try a different search boundary.

moments.bodyZh: 核对它是否回答了原来的问题，再收好这条来路。
moments.bodyEn: Check that it answers the original question and save the route back.

editorial.matchZh: 适合寻找资料、梳理线索，以及需要重新找到方向的你。
editorial.matchEn: For finding references, following clues, and regaining a sense of direction.

tagline.zh: 先划出今天这一格，再慢慢走向远处。
tagline.en: Choose today's small square before looking farther ahead.

description.zh: 计划不必一开始就完美，能让下一步更清楚就很好。
description.en: A plan need not be perfect to make the next step clearer.

editorial.promiseZh: 先划出今天这一格，再慢慢走向远处。
editorial.promiseEn: Choose today's small square before looking farther ahead.
editorial.storyTitleEn: The Small Squares on a Broad Tail
editorial.storyZh: 格格的宽尾巴上有一排浅浅的小格子，它总喜欢坐稳以后，才开始用前爪比划接下来的安排。小队第一次准备远行，愿望多得能写满整面墙，格格却先问大家：今天出门以前，哪一件事必须做好？它把最着急的一段放在前面，也给休息和意外留了位置。后来天气忽然变了，原来的路线不得不重画，格格没有为涂改而懊恼，只把尾巴挪近一点，和伙伴们重新确认下一小段。它相信计划的用处在于帮助行动，而不是让所有事情听从纸上的命令。待在你的桌边时，这只温暖的海狸会陪你把很大的目标看成能够慢慢靠近的小格子。
editorial.storyEn: Shallow squares run across Gege's broad tail. The beaver settles firmly before measuring the next stretch with its paws. When the crew planned its first long journey, their wishes filled an entire wall. Gege asked which task really had to be finished before leaving that day, then made room for rest and surprises as well as urgent work. When the weather changed, it moved its tail closer and helped everyone think through the next small stretch again. A plan, in Gege's world, exists to support action rather than command every future moment. Its steady presence makes a large destination feel like a series of places you can gradually reach.
editorial.comfortZh: 计划不必一开始就完美，能让下一步更清楚就很好。
editorial.comfortEn: A plan need not be perfect to make the next step clearer.

moments.bodyZh: 挑出今天能完成的一格，让起点看得见。
moments.bodyEn: Choose one square you can finish today so the starting point is visible.

moments.bodyZh: 重新确认重要顺序，允许路线跟着事实调整。
moments.bodyEn: Recheck the priorities and let the route respond to new facts.

moments.bodyZh: 为休息和缓冲留出位置，不必把每一格都填满。
moments.bodyEn: Leave room for rest and uncertainty; not every square needs filling.

editorial.matchZh: 适合拆解任务、安排长项目，以及需要找回清晰节奏的你。
editorial.matchEn: For breaking down tasks, planning long projects, and finding a clear pace.

tagline.zh: 快到终点的时候，陪你把最后一步走稳。
tagline.en: Near the finish, keep the final step steady.

description.zh: 作品值得被看见，也值得好好确认已经到达。
description.en: Your work deserves to be seen and its arrival deserves a careful check.

editorial.promiseZh: 快到终点的时候，陪你把最后一步走稳。
editorial.promiseEn: Near the finish, keep the final step steady.
editorial.storyTitleEn: One Last Look at the Harness
editorial.storyZh: 云递有一条亮眼的橙色背带，圆角小胶囊总贴在它背后。伙伴们把旅行中的小成果交给它时，它会先低头检查胸前的搭扣，再转过头看看胶囊有没有放稳。一次，庆祝的声音已经响起来，云递却仍站在出发点没有动。它发现目的地的灯刚换了位置，如果沿着旧方向走，就会把好消息送到空房间。等大家确认好新的落点，它才踏着短短的步子向前。回来时，背带上仍干干净净，伙伴们却都知道，那份看起来不忙的认真很重要。住在你的桌面上，云递会陪你经历准备亮相前的小紧张，提醒最后一步也值得和开头一样用心。
editorial.storyEn: Yundi wears an orange harness with a rounded capsule secured close to its back. Before setting out with the crew's small achievements, it checks the chest clasp and looks over its shoulder. Once, a celebration had already begun when the pigeon noticed that the destination light had moved. Following the old route would deliver good news to an empty room. It waited until the new destination was clear, then set off with short, deliberate steps. Its clean harness revealed little of the care involved, but the others understood. On your desktop, Yundi offers company for that nervous moment before showing work, when the final step deserves as much attention as the first.
editorial.comfortZh: 作品值得被看见，也值得好好确认已经到达。
editorial.comfortEn: Your work deserves to be seen and its arrival deserves a careful check.

moments.bodyZh: 再看一眼目标位置和当前版本，确认出发的正是这一份。
moments.bodyEn: Check the destination and current version before sending this exact result.

moments.bodyZh: 给结果一点时间，再从接收的一端确认它。
moments.bodyEn: Give the result a moment, then check from the receiving end.

moments.bodyZh: 把验证和来路记下来，让这次完成有个清楚的落点。
moments.bodyEn: Record the check and source so this completion has a clear endpoint.

editorial.matchZh: 适合作品发布、项目交接，以及在最后一步需要稳住心态的你。
editorial.matchEn: For publishing work, handing over projects, and staying steady near the finish.

tagline.zh: 重要的小事，值得给它留一个位置。
tagline.en: Give the small things that matter a place to stay.

description.zh: 不用把一切都记在脑海里，把重要的内容好好放下。
description.en: You do not need to hold everything in your head; give important things a home.

editorial.promiseZh: 重要的小事，值得给它留一个位置。
editorial.promiseEn: Give the small things that matter a place to stay.
editorial.storyTitleEn: A Quiet Click From the Acorn Pack
editorial.storyZh: 栗存背着一个薄荷绿的橡果小包，走到哪里都会先摸摸肩带，确认它还贴在身边。小队里有人记住了好看的颜色，有人记住了绕路的原因，栗存喜欢听完这些零碎的小事，再在晚上安静地回想一遍。一次大家准备重走旧路，却谁也想不起当初为什么绕过那座桥，栗存想起伙伴曾说过桥板松动的那一刻，也想起后来修好的日期。它没有把所有回忆混成一个模糊的印象，而是把前后顺序慢慢讲清楚。栗存的认真并不是永远不忘记，而是愿意给重要的线索一个可以回来寻找的位置。坐在桌边时，它会轻轻整理背包，陪你把今天值得留下的东西收好。
editorial.storyEn: Licun carries a mint-green acorn pack and checks its straps wherever it goes. It enjoys the crew's small observations: a memorable color, a reason for taking a detour, a moment worth returning to. When nobody could remember why they had once avoided a bridge, the squirrel recalled both the loose board and the later repair. It kept the order of those events clear instead of blending them into one vague impression. Licun's care is not a promise never to forget. It is the habit of giving useful clues somewhere to be found again. Beside your screen, the little pack and curled tail make quiet company while you save the things worth keeping.
editorial.comfortZh: 不用把一切都记在脑海里，把重要的内容好好放下。
editorial.comfortEn: You do not need to hold everything in your head; give important things a home.

moments.bodyZh: 用自己的话记下关键点，也留下最初的来源。
moments.bodyEn: Write the key point in your own words and keep its original source.

moments.titleEn: At the end of a day
moments.bodyZh: 只收好最值得留下的几件事，不必把一切都打包。
moments.bodyEn: Keep the few things worth returning to without saving everything.

moments.bodyZh: 先看看记录的时间和背景，再继续当时的思路。
moments.bodyEn: Check the date and context before continuing an earlier line of thought.

editorial.matchZh: 适合整理笔记、记录决定，以及希望给想法留个去处的你。
editorial.matchEn: For organizing notes, recording decisions, and giving ideas a place to return to.

tagline.zh: 事情再多，也可以一次理清一条线。
tagline.en: Even with plenty to consider, follow one thread at a time.

description.zh: 不必同时抓住所有事情，找到顺序就能慢慢理清。
description.en: You need not hold everything at once; a useful order makes room to think.

editorial.promiseZh: 事情再多，也可以一次理清一条线。
editorial.promiseEn: Even with plenty to consider, follow one thread at a time.
editorial.storyTitleEn: Eight Arms, One Rhythm
editorial.storyZh: 多多有八只短短的触手，却并不喜欢同时把所有东西举到空中。它的奶油色颈环上有三颗小珠子，触手尖会沿着珠子轻轻轮换，像给自己的忙碌定下一个稳定的节拍。一次小队收到许多大小不同的路线碎片，大家急着把它们拼在一起，桌面反而越来越乱。多多先收拢触手，留出一小片空位，让相同来源的碎片靠在一起，再慢慢比较它们的先后和边缘。等图案清楚起来，它才伸出下一只手。伙伴们这才发现，能照顾很多事情，并不等于每一秒都要做很多事。在你的桌面上，多多会用有次序的小动作，陪你从杂乱里找回一条可以跟住的线。
editorial.storyEn: Duoduo has eight short arms but does not try to lift everything at once. Its tentacle tips take turns touching the beads on a cream collar, setting a calm rhythm. When the crew received a confusing stack of route fragments, hurried attempts to join them only filled the desk with more clutter. Duoduo curled its arms inward, made a small clear space, and grouped pieces by their source before comparing their edges and order. Only when one section made sense did the next arm move. Having room for many things, the crew learned, did not mean handling them all at the same instant. On your desktop, the octopus brings that measured rhythm to busy moments.
editorial.comfortZh: 不必同时抓住所有事情，找到顺序就能慢慢理清。
editorial.comfortEn: You need not hold everything at once; a useful order makes room to think.

moments.bodyZh: 先分清来源和范围，再比较具体内容。
moments.bodyEn: Separate sources and scope before comparing the details.

moments.bodyZh: 选一条能先理顺的线，让其他事情暂时有处可放。
moments.bodyEn: Choose one thread to untangle and give the others somewhere to wait.

moments.bodyZh: 换个例子确认一下，再决定这个规律能用到哪里。
moments.bodyEn: Check another example before deciding how far the pattern applies.

editorial.matchZh: 适合数据整理、多线任务，以及想从复杂信息里找回顺序的你。
editorial.matchEn: For organizing data, managing several threads, and finding order in complex information.

tagline.zh: 少一点拥挤，让真正重要的东西被看见。
tagline.en: Make a little room for what really matters.

description.zh: 好看也可以很清楚，先把最重要的意思留住。
description.en: Beautiful can also be clear; start with the meaning that matters most.

editorial.promiseZh: 少一点拥挤，让真正重要的东西被看见。
editorial.promiseEn: Make a little room for what really matters.
editorial.storyTitleEn: Three Colors Along a Tail
editorial.storyZh: 彩尾的尾巴上只有三段醒目的颜色：珊瑚橙、青绿和暖黄。它并不是不喜欢别的颜色，只是喜欢看清每一种颜色在什么地方最合适。小队要做一张欢迎新伙伴的告示时，大家把喜欢的装饰都加了上去，最后连见面的时间都不容易找到。彩尾没有立刻换上一套新花样，而是先把最重要的一句话放到大家一眼能看见的位置，再一点点留出空白。它用前爪托着下巴看了很久，直到欢迎的意思不再需要解释。来到你的桌边，它仍会在尾巴的颜色之间来回张望，提醒创作也可以从温柔的删减开始，让作品留出给别人理解的空间。
editorial.storyEn: Caiwei's tail carries just three bright bands: coral, teal, and warm yellow. The red panda likes other colors too, but enjoys discovering where each one belongs. When the crew made a welcome notice, everyone added a favorite decoration until the meeting time was hard to find. Caiwei did not replace the clutter with a different flourish. It moved the most important sentence where everyone could see it, then made a little space around it. With a paw under its chin, it watched until the welcome no longer needed explaining. On your desktop, its thoughtful glances between the tail bands suggest a gentle starting point for design: leave room for someone else to understand.
editorial.comfortZh: 好看也可以很清楚，先把最重要的意思留住。
editorial.comfortEn: Beautiful can also be clear; start with the meaning that matters most.

moments.bodyZh: 说清最重要的一件事，再决定其他元素是否需要留下。
moments.bodyEn: Name the main point before deciding which other elements should stay.

moments.bodyZh: 先确认层次和阅读顺序，再挑喜欢的颜色。
moments.bodyEn: Set the hierarchy and reading order before choosing favorite colors.

moments.bodyZh: 停一下，从第一次看到它的人那里重新看一眼。
moments.bodyEn: Pause and look again as someone encountering it for the first time.

editorial.matchZh: 适合视觉设计、内容整理，以及在表达上想做减法的你。
editorial.matchEn: For visual design, shaping content, and finding clarity through simplification.

tagline.zh: 留意边界，也给自己留一份安心。
tagline.en: Notice the boundaries and leave yourself room for peace of mind.

description.zh: 谨慎不是不敢前进，而是知道自己正站在哪里。
description.en: Being careful means knowing where you stand before moving ahead.

editorial.promiseZh: 留意边界，也给自己留一份安心。
editorial.promiseEn: Notice the boundaries and leave yourself room for peace of mind.
editorial.storyTitleEn: The Hedgehog Who Opened Its Collar
editorial.storyZh: 盾盾身上的铜色小刺并不尖锐，它常把前爪轻轻放在奶油色护领旁，认真看着来来往往的伙伴。一次小队准备开放自己的小屋，大家急着把所有门都打开，盾盾却先绕着屋子走了一圈，把可以分享的房间和存放私人日记的柜子分清楚。它不是不欢迎客人，只是不希望热闹过后，有人发现重要的东西被误拿走。确认好边界以后，盾盾第一个张开前爪，把新朋友迎进门。它的温柔一直和谨慎待在一起，没有因为小心就把整个世界关在外面。来到你的桌面，它会以安稳的姿态陪着你，让一次停顿和确认也能成为继续前进的力量。
editorial.storyEn: Dundun's copper spines are softly rounded. It often rests its paws beside a cream collar and watches the crew come and go. Before opening their little house to visitors, the hedgehog walked through it to distinguish shared rooms from cupboards holding private diaries. It wanted guests to feel welcome without anyone discovering afterward that something personal had been carried away by mistake. Once the boundaries were clear, Dundun was the first to open its paws in greeting. Care and warmth belong together in its world. Beside your screen, its steady posture offers company for the pause that helps you decide where and how to take the next step.
editorial.comfortZh: 谨慎不是不敢前进，而是知道自己正站在哪里。
editorial.comfortEn: Being careful means knowing where you stand before moving ahead.

moments.bodyZh: 看看哪些内容适合公开，哪些只需要留给自己。
moments.bodyEn: Notice what belongs in public and what should stay with you.

moments.bodyZh: 把范围说清楚，让选择有具体的依据。
moments.bodyEn: Make the scope clear so the choice rests on something concrete.

moments.bodyZh: 先找一个可以核实的小问题，给下一步一点支撑。
moments.bodyEn: Find one small question you can verify to support the next step.

editorial.matchZh: 适合检查边界、仔细交接，以及喜欢安稳陪伴的你。
editorial.matchEn: For checking boundaries, careful handovers, and reassuring company.

tagline.zh: 结果还没来，也可以先好好呼吸。
tagline.en: While the result is on its way, take a comfortable breath.

description.zh: 等待也是工作的一部分，你不必一直紧绷着。
description.en: Waiting is part of the work too; you do not have to stay tense through it.

editorial.promiseZh: 结果还没来，也可以先好好呼吸。
editorial.promiseEn: While the result is on its way, take a comfortable breath.
editorial.storyTitleEn: A Soft Seat for the Wait
editorial.storyZh: 慢慢的淡紫色颈枕总安稳地搭在肩上，长长的手臂摆动起来，像一句没有催促的招呼。小队有一回等着远处的灯重新亮起，越等越着急，有人反复探头，有人不停计算已经过去多久。慢慢没有假装知道灯什么时候会亮，只挪出一张舒服的位置，陪大家把呼吸放缓。它偶尔抬头看看变化，也会在需要回应时张开双臂，让伙伴知道自己仍在这里。后来灯终于亮了，慢慢和大家一起起身，没有把这段安静的时间算成浪费。待在你的桌面上，它不会替结果安排时间，只会用松弛的姿态提醒你：事情还在等待的时候，你也值得被好好照顾。
editorial.storyEn: A pale-lilac pillow rests on Manman's shoulders, and its long arms move like an unhurried greeting. Once the crew waited for a distant light to return. Some kept peering out; others counted the minutes again and again. The sloth did not pretend to know when the light would appear. It simply made a comfortable place to sit and stayed nearby, occasionally looking up and opening its arms when someone needed a response. When the light finally returned, Manman rose with the others without treating the quiet interval as wasted time. On your desktop, it does not promise a faster result. Its relaxed presence makes space for you to breathe while you wait.
editorial.comfortZh: 等待也是工作的一部分，你不必一直紧绷着。
editorial.comfortEn: Waiting is part of the work too; you do not have to stay tense through it.

moments.bodyZh: 把眼睛从进度上挪开一会儿，让肩膀松下来。
moments.bodyEn: Look away from the progress for a moment and relax your shoulders.

moments.bodyZh: 留一个合适的回看时间，不必每分钟都确认一次。
moments.bodyEn: Choose a reasonable time to check back rather than checking every minute.

moments.bodyZh: 先看清现在发生了什么，再用自己的节奏接着做。
moments.bodyEn: Notice what has changed and resume at a pace that works for you.

editorial.matchZh: 适合长任务、等待反馈，以及想让工作节奏柔和一点的你。
editorial.matchEn: For long tasks, waiting for feedback, and finding a gentler working pace.

tagline.zh: 先抓住一个变化，再慢慢走近原因。
tagline.en: Start with one change and work your way toward the cause.

description.zh: 问题还没解开也没关系，排除一条错误方向同样算进展。
description.en: Ruling out an unhelpful direction is progress even before the answer appears.

editorial.promiseZh: 先抓住一个变化，再慢慢走近原因。
editorial.promiseEn: Start with one change and work your way toward the cause.
editorial.storyTitleZh: 从暗红到琥珀的一小段
editorial.storyTitleEn: One Small Step From Ember to Amber
editorial.storyZh: 火花背上的鳍脊连成一道柔软的弧线，颜色从暗红慢慢过渡到琥珀橙。它遇到问题时并不会立刻跳起来，反而喜欢先站稳，用前爪轻轻碰一碰自己能确认的位置。有次小队的信号灯时亮时暗，大家各自提出了不同猜测，火花却只问：刚才哪一个动作发生以后，灯变了？伙伴们顺着这句话把经过重新走了一遍，发现变化总出现在同一处松动的接点。它没有因为第一次没猜中而失去精神，也没有把猜测说成答案。回到桌面以后，这只机敏的小蜥蜴仍会一点点转动目光，陪你记录观察、缩小范围，并为每一个真实的小发现留出一点开心。
editorial.storyEn: Huohua's soft dorsal frill forms one continuous curve, shading from deep ember to amber. Faced with a problem, the salamander settles its feet and checks the points it can actually observe. When the crew's signal light began flickering, everyone suggested a different explanation. Huohua asked which action had happened just before the light changed. Walking through the sequence again revealed a loose connection at the same point each time. It was not discouraged by an earlier wrong guess, and never confused a guess with a finding. On your desktop, its attentive glances keep you company while observations narrow the possibilities and small discoveries begin to add up.
editorial.comfortZh: 问题还没解开也没关系，排除一条错误方向同样算进展。
editorial.comfortEn: Ruling out an unhelpful direction is progress even before the answer appears.

moments.bodyZh: 先记录看到的现象，暂时把猜测放在一旁。
moments.bodyEn: Record what you observed before settling on an explanation.

moments.bodyZh: 一次只改变一件事，让每次结果都能说明一点什么。
moments.bodyEn: Change one thing at a time so each result tells you something.

moments.bodyZh: 再走一遍原来的过程，确认这次变化真的有帮助。
moments.bodyEn: Repeat the original sequence to confirm that the change actually helps.

editorial.matchZh: 适合排查问题、验证假设，以及在反复尝试中需要好心态的你。
editorial.matchEn: For investigating problems, testing ideas, and staying hopeful through repeated attempts.
